financings_after_balance_sheet.what: ATM sales of common stock, Oct 1 to Nov 13, 2024
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: From October 1, 2024 to November 13, 2024, the Company issued an aggregate of 1,434,368 shares of common stock under the December 2021 ATM Agreement for total net proceeds of $1.7 million.

warrants.quote: the Company issued (i) Iliad warrants to purchase up to 13,779 shares of the common stock, (ii) Uptown warrants to purchase up to 18,296 shares of the common stock, and (iii) Streeterville warrants to purchase up to 31,547 shares of the common stock, at an exercise price of $28.8 per share.
the Company agreed to issue Iliad warrants to purchase up to 3,875 shares of the Company’s common stock at an exercise price of $22.2 per share.
the Company agreed to issue to Uptown warrants to purchase up to 4,375 shares of the Company’s common stock at an exercise price of $22.2 per share.
